g.text: Example branches from the flu search.
Each node is a newly fitted recipe;
no branch scores are drawn here.
Code fits every candidate and seed;
evaluates the same tasks and labels
Code ranks by log-admission WIS; lower is better.
Repeat seeds before continuing a branch.
The flu search required ≥4 seeds before expansion.
LLM uses measured scores to propose the next round.
Repeated selection on the same seasons is not an untouched test.

g.text: Yellow: hide 3 weeks in every 16, starting after the first 4 weeks of each training season.
Those weeks are absent from inner-fit inputs, labels and scaling statistics.
After epoch selection, refit on all blue + yellow weeks. Red weeks supply no fitting labels.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: This is retrospective CV: a fit may use seasons later than its evaluation season.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202c35

g.text: C Inside one fold: select the epoch, then fit a fresh model
Curves are illustrative, not run results.
Do this separately for all three folds.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202c35

g.text: Example patience: 25 epochs without improvement; cap: 240 epochs.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #202c35

g.text: Researcher selects recipes → fresh release fits on 2022-23 through 2025-26 → freeze checkpoints → weekly inputs, no refitting

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202c35

g.text: Training inputs: reference flu admissions / ED histories, perturbed with prescribed 2025-26 reporting errors; tree children change the stated settings.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202c35

g.text: Prediction labels: September 2026 reference future admissions / ED, plus 4 recent reference weeks for auxiliary reconstruction in the quantile parent.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202c35

g.text: Evaluation inputs: 3 shared artificial preliminary histories per task from that reporting process; each saved fit updates the newest 2 weeks before forecasting.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202c35

g.text: Each CV row fits on the other three completed seasons and scores its red season. The LLM proposes recipes; numerical losses and WIS come from code.
